selection: Choose the legal move maximizing POSITION_WEIGHTS[y][x]; break ties by ascending y then x.

parameters.position_weights: Defined in ai_engine.py; human-set provisional values, not trained.

reproducibility_scope: Frozen script and engine bytes; evaluation reproduction also requires the recorded harness, opening population, seeds, and runtime. No cross-version guarantee.
limitations: No Minimax, mobility search, Alpha-Beta, or learned parameters.
The AI does not consume or enforce internal search-budget configuration.
The AI does not emit trace4 evidence; these results are descriptive and not formal strength evidence.
